integrity: A self-contained proof is accompanied by exact-rational and numerical regression checks. Finite computations do not certify the universal theorem. Historical searches and the self-review do not establish independent novelty validation.
scientific_limitations: Uniform stationary law; one leaf per cycle node; classwise constant prices; continuous-time symmetric rates; linear budget. No assertions for discrete-time SLEM, normalized Laplacian, arbitrary attachments, vertex masses or nonuniform prices.
scientific_scope: For every integer \(n\ge3\) and pendant-edge price \(t>0\), maximize the second eigenvalue of the ordinary symmetric Laplacian of an n-sunlet under a unit two-class linear conductance budget, allowing arbitrary individual edge allocations.
title: Unique price-optimal fastest mixing on sunlet networks
